Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- S. Shekhar,Rajeev Upadhyay

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Rajeev Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra, learned AGA for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 604 of 2019, under Sections 416, 420, 467, 468 & 471 IPC, Police Station Civil Lines, District Moradabad, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and five others and according to the FIR,
on the basis of forged document applicant and other co-accused persons were trying to take possession over the property of the informant.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and in fact, applicant never tried to take possession over the property of the informant alongwith other co-accused.

He further submitted that even as per allegation,
applicant and others are only trying to take possession over the property of informant and except this, there is no other allegation against the applicant.

He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 11.1.2023, therefore, he may be Ram Raj Vishnoi vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39069441/
1 released on bail.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that only allegation against the applicant is that he and other co-accused were trying to take possession over the property of the informant on the basis of fake document and except this there is no other allegation against the applicant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the FIR, it appears that allegation against the applicant and other co-accused person is that they are trying to take possession over the property of the informant on the basis of forged document and except that there is no other allegation.
Therefore, considering the nature of allegation with regard to the applicant and from the discussions made above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Ram Raj Vishnoi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Ankita  Ram Raj Vishnoi vs State Of U.P. on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39069441/
